name: evermore
llm_description: evermore is Taylor Swift's ninth studio album, a companion piece to folklore that continues its folk and alternative sound, extending the fictional storytelling into themes of endings, grief, and moving on.
llm_emotion_analysis: Melancholy and contemplative; autumnal, reflective moods of heartbreak, acceptance, and quiet resilience.
llm_overall_public_reception: Critically acclaimed; praised as a strong sister record to folklore with continued artistic maturity, earning Grammy nomination and number-one debuts worldwide.
